m: जस् cl. 1. Ā. (p. जसमान) to be exhausted or starved, RV. i, 112, 6; vii, 68, 8: P. जसति, to go, Naigh. ii, 14: cl. 4. P. to liberate, Dhātup. xxvi, 102 : Caus. जासयति (aor. अजीजसत, 2. du. जजस्तम्) to exhaust, weaken, cause to expire, RV. iv, 50, 11; ŚBr. ii, 2, 2, 19; xii, 4, 3, 9; to hurt (cf. Pāṇ. ii, 3, 56), Dhātup. xxxii, 127; to strike, xxxiii, 44; to contemn, ib.; cf. उज्-, नि-; प्रोज्जासन.
a: जस् — {vI.v} {c4c} P. (जस्यति) 1 To set free, release. --2 To be exhausted or tired. --3 To go. {vII.v} {c1c} {c10c} P. (जसति, जासयति) 1 To hurt, injure, strike. --2 To disregard, slight.

s: i ka rakzaRe । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (curAMparaM-sakaM-sew .) i ka, jaMsayati । iti durgAdAsaH ॥

u ir ya mokze । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (divAM-paraM-sakaM-sew । udittvAt ktrAvew .) u, jasitvA jastvA । ir, ajasat ajAsIt । asmAt puzAditvAt nityaM Na ityanye । ya, jasyati vatsaM gopaH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
ka vaDe । anAdare । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (curAM-paraM-sakaM-sew .) ka, jAsayati । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: mokzaRe divA॰ para॰ saka॰ sew । jasyati irit ajasat ajAsIt ajasIt jajAsa jesatuH ajasram । udit jasitvA jastvA । jastaH ।

baDe anAdare ca curA॰ uBa॰ saka॰ sew । jAsayati te ajIjasat va । ud + hiMsane । etadyoge karmmaRi zazWI । “nijOjasojjAsamituM jagaddruhAm” mATaH । “DftyA nATasya vEdehi! manyorujjAsayAtmanaH” BawwiH ।
gatO niGaRwuH BvA॰ para॰ saka॰ sew । jasati ajA(ja)sIt । jasistAqane upakzaye ca mADavaH । jasuriH ।
rakzaRe cu॰ uBa॰ saka॰ sew idit । jaMsayati te aja jaMsat ta ।

m: जस्स-राज N. of a man, Rājat. vii.

v: pu॰ jasa--un । AyuDe “yadA balasya pIyato jasum” f॰ 10 । 68 । 6 । “jasumAyuDam” BA॰ ।
m: जसु f. exhaustion, weakness, RV. x, 33, 2

s: puM, (jasyate mucyate hanyate vA'neneti । jasa + “jasisahorurin .” uRAM । 2 । 73 । iti urin .) vajram । ityuRAdikozaH ॥
v: pu॰ jasa--urin । 1 vajre ujjvaladattaH 2 vyATite tri॰ “vi yA jAnAti jasurim” f॰ 5 । 61 । 7 । “jasuriM vyaTitam” “jasistAqanakarmyopakzayakarmmA vA” BA॰ । 3 upakzayayukte ca ।
m: जसुरि mfn. starved, RV. i, 116, 22; iv, 38, 5; v, 61, 7; vi, 13, 5
जसुरि m. Indra's thunderbolt, Uṇ., Sch.
a: जसुरि — a. Ved. Exhausted, tired. --रिः Indra's thunderbolt.

v: tri॰ jasa--upakzaye vanip । upakzayakarttari “mA svajane vfzaBa!” f॰ 6 । 40 । 11 । “jasvane upakzayiRe” BA॰ ।
m: जस्वन् mfn. needy, hungry, RV. vi, 44, 11.
